title: AI-SDLC Project Template: AI-Assisted Software Development Life Cycle
description: The reusable project template for the AI-Assisted Software Development Life Cycle (AI-SDLC), a lightweight and spec-driven lifecycle for AI-assisted software development. The template provides repository-local guidance, phase-specific Agent Skills, specifications, task-state and architecture artifacts, and supporting project configuration.
